title: Device Inventory Info event (asset-management reconciliation telemetry for the operator's authoritative inventory ledger)
summary: OCSF Device Inventory Info events the operator's asset-management surface emits at each reconciliation against an authoritative inventory source. Carries the per-asset identity, observed-source attribution, and reconciliation timestamp so the kpi.unmanaged_asset_cardinality@v1 and kri.asset_inventory_drift@v1 indicators can read asset identity and per-window delta evidence off a single OCSF class shape. Vendor-neutral binding: the catalog entry pins the OCSF Device Inventory Info class (uid 5001), not a CMDB or asset-API product object.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Discovery category — Device Inventory Info class (uid 5001)
